Jubayed Ahmed Sahel
Overall Experience:
Honestly, CSE323 with SSI sir was kind of mixed for me. A lot of the time I personally couldn’t fully understand his lectures, and sometimes he himself seemed a bit confused while explaining. But one good thing is that he was fairly generous with grading, so in the end most students were satisfied with their grades. So if you get him, I’d say you can take the course without worrying too much.
Another thing I noticed is that he appreciates students who actually try in class. If he sees someone responding, asking questions, or at least trying to understand the topic, he usually gives a decent curve.
Class & Attendance
Even though his teaching style may not be everyone’s favorite, he often gives important hints and suggestions during class about exams and important topics. Those small hints actually help a lot later, so attending classes regularly is a good idea.
Also, attendance was worth 10%, so missing too many classes could hurt your marks.
Quizzes & Exams
There were 3 quizzes in total, but only the best 2 counted. Most quiz questions were pretty direct and mainly came from the slides and assignments.
But the midterm and final were a different story. The questions were much trickier, and a few questions even came from topics that weren’t properly covered in class. Because of that, self-study was super important for this course. Honestly, I had to learn many things on my own outside class.
I somehow managed to get an A-, but it definitely required a lot of effort and practice by myself.
Project
The project section was actually one of the chill parts of the course. I did most of my project using Gemini’s help and still got a pretty good grade. There wasn’t any in-class presentation either.
After finishing the project, we had to record a screen-recorded video (maximum 5 minutes) explaining the project features with our own voice. The time limit was strict, so the video couldn’t go over 5 minutes.
Then we had to upload the video to YouTube (private or public, both were okay). The project code also had to be uploaded to GitHub, and the YouTube video link needed to be added there too.
Finally, both the GitHub link and YouTube link had to be included in the report, and we only had to submit the report on Canvas.
